# DoomPi

Package-owned guidance for using and extending the DoomPi distribution.

## How to author

- [Author a DoomPi extension](./src/prompts/doompi-author-extension/SKILL.md): Create or update a DoomPi extension inside or outside this monorepo.
- [Extension authoring contract](./src/prompts/doompi-author-extension/references/extension-contract.md): Package shape, Cordis lifecycle, Help contribution, and verification requirements.

## Package reference

- [Package README](./README.md): Installation, configuration, modes, domains, profiles, and runtime behavior.
